title: IP Addresses
help: Choose which of this server's addresses websites and mail may use. A shared address serves everyone; a dedicated one only its owner's websites.
resellerHelp: Addresses the admin dedicated to you. Give one to a customer, or keep it for your own websites.
discoveryFailed: The server's addresses could not be listed ({error}). You can still type an address.
publicHelp: Behind NAT (most cloud servers) the server has a private address. Enter the public address here: DNS gets it, the gateway listens on the private one.
label: Label
addHelp: The first address you add becomes the main IP, which websites use unless they pick another. Dedicate an address to a user or reseller after adding it.
emptyAdmin: The pool is empty. Every website uses the server's address as before until you add one.
emptyReseller: No address is dedicated to you yet.
defaultSiteHelp: Shown when someone opens this address directly in a browser.
confirmMain: Make {address} the main IP? Websites that follow the main IP move to it, and their DNS records that held the old main IP are changed.
